title: CCPowerGridCompat
description: Adds methods to the PowerGrid gauges to allow for CC: Tweaked computers to directly read them as peripherals
body:
# CCPowerGridCompat

This mod adds methods to CC:Tweaked to enable computers to read directly from the Create: PowerGrid Gauges. The direct values from the Voltage Gauge, Current Gauge, and Power Gauge are now readable as peripherals, with the `getVoltage`, `getAmperage`, and `getPower` methods, respectively.

Simple as.
